title_en: Information Session on the 2027 Undergraduate Start-up and Advanced Research Innovative Talent Support Program
summary: Undergraduate students enrolled in the second semester of their first year as of Fall 2026 may attend an information session on the 2027 Undergraduate Start-up and Advanced Research Innovative Talent Support Program. The session will be held on Tuesday, 20 October 2026, from 17:00 in Room 422, Global Engineering Education Center (Building 38). Students who wish to attend must apply individually through the Google Form by Thursday, 15 October 2026; places are limited to 100 on a first-come, first-served basis.
applies_to: Undergraduate (bachelor's program) students enrolled (재적생) in the second semester of their first year as of Fall 2026 (2026-2학기). Attendance is voluntary; students who wish to attend must apply. Places are limited to 100, first come, first served.

conditions: Only undergraduate students enrolled in the second semester of their first year as of Fall 2026 are eligible to apply.

Attend the information session on Tuesday, 20 October 2026, from 17:00 in Room 422, Global Engineering Education Center (Building 38).
translation:
Information Session on the 2027 「Undergraduate Start-up and Advanced Research Innovative Talent Support Program」

We announce that an information session on the 2027 academic year 「Undergraduate Start-up and Advanced Research Innovative Talent Support Program」 will be held as follows. We encourage your interest and participation.

A. Event overview
1) Date and time: Tuesday, 20 October 2026, from 17:00
2) Venue: Room 422, Global Engineering Education Center (Building 38)
3) Content: Information on the selection of innovative talent for the 2027 academic year, question-and-answer session, etc.

B. Application for attendance
1) Eligibility: Undergraduate (bachelor's program) students enrolled in the second semester of their first year as of Fall 2026 (2026-2학기)
2) Capacity: 100 people (first come, first served)
3) Application deadline and method
- Deadline: by Thursday, 15 October 2026
- Method: Students who wish to attend must complete and submit the Google Form themselves. ※ Application link: https://forms.gle/eJHo4kxMkEVC4eacA
